judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and using default import `import Ajv from 'ajv'` in an ESM project (which fails TypeScript/Node ESM checks compared to the reference's `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`). In `ToolRegistry`, `strict: false` causes Ajv not to throw on unknown schema types unless `validateSchema` runs or fails, or rather the candidate omits logging on validation failure altogether despite the ticket requiring rejection log lines naming the failing property paths. Most notably, the candidate is missing updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and the required one-line JSDoc on `execute`. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts`, several required unit tests are absent (extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema changing between calls, unknown tool throw, single compilation across 10 calls), and the test assertions violate repo lint rules (`re-lint` single-assertion/spec-link rules).
